summary: No change again, and I am leaving it that way: submission.json contains only a rationale stating that no sources, investigations, knowledge, gaps, interpretations or experiment are added. Validation of those bytes was read-only and reported valid with no diagnostics. All questions this run opened are recorded as explained, with a retained receipt where the answer was measured (the rctx-coalescing starvation and its stale-index child, the deferred-read release that holds, the empty-Entries read-index abort and the undecodable conf-change proposal abort including the unvalidated follower relay, the silent conf-change replacement, the last-voter apply abort, the removed-leader stall with its step-down control, external-trigger boundary and varied-schedule reproduction, and the Node API's deadline-only signal) and an explicit source-only basis where it was not (the lease-read preconditions), no necessary gap is open, and no execution lacks an interpretation. Because the remaining budget expires with this turn, a new experiment could not receive the interpretation that makes it a conclusion and another sourced entry would repeat mechanisms already recorded, so neither would be useful investigation; expiry preserves the existing work without a closing call, and defect validity, CFT relevance and deduplication remain with human offline review.
